blocks.raw: Earlier this month we announced new APIs that it will make it easier to settle with DriveWealth. We called this One Settlement. So no matter your funding method "One" settlement to rule them all.

blocks.raw: Please be reminded that effective **May 28, 2024** as per Securities & Exchange Commission; the industry is moving to a Trade Day + 1 (T+1). To learn more about T+1 settlement, please see [here](https://www.sec.gov/oiea/investor-alerts-and-bulletins/new-t1-settlement-cycle-what-investors-need-know-investor).
